stories.title: EN DIRECT - Sommet États-Unis/Chine : XI se dit impatient de traiter de la «situation mondiale» avec Trump

en.title: LIVE - US/China Summit: Xi says he is eager to discuss 'global situation' with Trump
en.summary: Xi Jinping is visiting the United States with the primary goal of extending the commercial truce between Washington and Beijing. Trump has arranged a warm reception for the Chinese president.

stories.title: Un juge américain ordonne à la Maison Blanche de rouvrir son accès à CNN, MS NOW et Politico

en.title: American judge orders White House to restore access to CNN, MS NOW and Politico
en.summary: A judge ruled that revoking press credentials for three media outlets without notice likely violated constitutional press freedom rights. The executive branch was ordered to immediately return journalist badges.

stories.title: États-Unis - Chine : Donald Trump accueille chaleureusement Xi Jinping à l'aéroport

en.title: United States - China: Donald Trump warmly welcomes Xi Jinping at the airport
en.summary: Trump greeted Xi Jinping at the airport during a state visit aimed at extending the commercial truce between the two countries. Further talks are planned between the leaders.

stories.title: «Nos intérêts sont étroitement liés» : les images de l’arrivée de Xi Jinping aux États-Unis

en.title: "Our interests are closely linked": images of Xi Jinping's arrival in the United States
en.summary: Talks between Chinese and American leaders are expected to address trade, technological competition, and Beijing's support for Iran.

stories.title: Désaccords sur le Proche-Orient et LFI, convergences sur les salaires… Ce qu'il faut retenir du premier débat de la primaire socialiste

en.title: Disagreements on Middle East and LFI, convergence on wages… What to remember from the first Socialist primary debate
en.summary: Five candidates in October's Socialist primary debate showed agreement on economic proposals but disagreed on international issues and their relationship with La France insoumise.

stories.title: EN DIRECT, guerre en Ukraine : Volodymyr Zelensky favorable à une rencontre avec Donald Trump et Vladimir Poutine au G20 à Miami

en.title: LIVE, war in Ukraine: Volodymyr Zelensky favorable to a meeting with Donald Trump and Vladimir Putin at the G20 in Miami
en.summary: Ukraine's president expressed support for a potential meeting involving Trump and Putin at the G20 summit scheduled for December in Miami.

stories.title: Une visite d’État de trois jours : Xi Jinping en position de force face à Donald Trump

en.title: A three-day state visit: Xi Jinping in a position of strength facing Donald Trump
en.summary: China's president was received by his American counterpart in Washington for the first time in eleven years, treated with considerable diplomatic standing.

stories.title: Un juge américain ordonne à la présidence américaine de rétablir l'accès à la Maison Blanche de trois médias bannis par Donald Trump

en.title: An American judge orders the American presidency to restore White House access to three media outlets banned by Donald Trump
en.summary: A federal judge required the restoration of White House access for CNN, MS Now, and Politico after the president had blocked them, accusing them of spreading false information.

stories.title: Un juge contraint Trump à rétablir l’accès à la Maison Blanche des médias CNN, MS NOW et Politico

en.title: Judge orders Trump to restore White House access for CNN, MSNBC and Politico media
en.summary: A judge has ruled that Trump must restore press credentials for CNN, MSNBC and Politico at the White House.

stories.title: Neuf morts en Ukraine après une série de frappes russes, Volodymyr Zelensky dénonce la «folie» meurtrière de Poutine devant l’ONU

en.title: Nine dead in Ukraine after series of Russian strikes; Volodymyr Zelensky denounces Putin's murderous "madness" before UN
en.summary: Russia launched approximately twenty ballistic missiles at Ukraine's capital, killing nine people, while the Ukrainian president was in New York seeking stronger sanctions from Congress members.

stories.title: Primaire à gauche : la situation à Gaza et l’alliance avec LFI électrisent le premier débat télévisé

en.title: Left primary: Gaza situation and alliance with LFI electrify first televised debate
en.summary: Five left-wing candidates debated on LCI, finding agreement on economic and social issues but clashing over whether to use the term "genocide" regarding Gaza.

stories.title: «Ce n’est pas quelqu’un à l’extérieur du PS qui va définir la refondation de la gauche» : Glucksmann endure les attaques de Royal lors du premier débat de la primaire socialiste

en.title: "It's not someone outside the PS who will define the refoundation of the left": Glucksmann endures Royal's attacks in first socialist primary debate
en.summary: Five primary candidates debated on LCI, with their main disagreement centering on the strategic question of alignment with the radical left party LFI.

stories.title: Un téléport incendié en Pologne : un « sabotage » selon le gouvernement

en.title: A teleport set on fire in Poland: "sabotage" according to the government
en.summary: A fire broke out at a teleport facility in central Poland connected to the Starlink network, which Ukraine and its military use. Authorities are investigating sabotage as the primary theory.

stories.title: Les salariés adoptent l’IA plus vite que leur entreprise et que leur patron

en.title: Employees adopt AI faster than their company and their boss
en.summary: Workers are becoming familiar with generative AI and using it personally, while companies struggle to establish policies governing these new applications in the workplace.

stories.title: Diesel : la menace d’un embargo américain fait déjà flamber les prix en Europe

en.title: Diesel: the threat of an American embargo is already driving up prices in Europe
en.summary: European diesel contracts rose up to 7 percent following statements by Donald Trump and reports of a temporary U.S. export ban. Markets are assessing risks to transportation, industry, and inflation despite White House denials of a 90-day embargo.

stories.title: OPINION. « Souveraineté numérique : malgré les alertes, l’aveuglement persiste »

en.title: OPINION. "Digital sovereignty: despite warnings, blindness persists"
en.summary: This is an opinion piece discussing a disconnect between public statements supporting digital sovereignty and actual implementation choices regarding data hosting, cybersecurity, and government procurement.

stories.title: OPINION. « Après DORA, l’EBA encadre les prestataires non informatiques »

en.title: OPINION. "After DORA, the EBA regulates non-IT service providers"
en.summary: The European Banking Authority has released guidelines on managing risks from non-IT subcontractors, modeling them on regulatory requirements similar to DORA standards.
